If the bidder wants to avail themselves of the reservation benefit, the bidder must be the manufacturer / OEM of the offered product on GeM. Benefits of MSE will be allowed only if seller is validated on-line in GeM profile as well as validated and approved by Buyer after evaluation of documents submitted. 10. In respect of bid for Services, the bidder must be the Service provider of the offered Service. Relevant documentary evidence in this regard shall

be uploaded along with the bid in respect of the offered product or service and Buyer will decide eligibility for purchase preference based on documentary evidence submitted, while evaluating the bid. If L-1 is not an MSE and MSE Seller (s) has / have quoted price within L-1+ 15 % of margin of purchase preference /price band defined in relevant policy, such MSE Seller shall be given opportunity to match L-1 price and contract will be awarded for 100 percentage of total quantity. Benefits of MSE will be allowed only if seller is validated on-line in GeM profile as well as validated and approved by Buyer after evaluation of documents submitted. 11. DD should be made in favour of Konkan Railway Corporation Limited payable at Jammu . After award of contract, Successful Bidder can upload scanned copy of the DD in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy to the original DD to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 12. FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of Konkan Railway Corporation Limited A/C (Name of the Seller). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. Successful Bidder to indicate Contract number and name of Seller entity in the transaction details field at the time of on-line transfer. Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the Online Payment Transfer in place of PBG within 15 days of award of contract. 14. Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date.

15. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Fixed Deposit Receipt made out or pledged in the name of A/C Konkan Railway Corporation Limited . The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. Bidder to indicate bid number and name of bidding entity in the transaction details field at the time of on- line transfer. Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the Online Payment Transfer along with bid. 17. Generic 1. The Seller shall not assign the Contract in whole or part without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 2. The Seller shall not sub-contract the Contract in whole or part to any entity without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 3. The Seller shall, notwithstanding the consent and assignment/sub-contract, remain jointly and severally liable and responsible to buyer together with the assignee/ sub-contractor, for and in respect of the due performance of the Contract and the Sellers obligations there under. 18. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses a) The Bidder must have a valid Office Registration Certificate and/or GST Registration Certifi cate issued by the Government of Jammu & Kashmir (UT). Copies of the relevant certificate s in support of the same shall be submitted along with the bid. b) Supplier shall ensure that the Invoice is raised in the name of Consignee with GSTIN of Con signee only. c) To be eligible for award of contract, Bidder / OEM must possess following Certificates / Test Reports on the date of bid opening (to be uploaded with bid): Project Experience Eligibility Criteria & Bidder Turnover, Certificate of registration, PAN Card, GST Registration, PF & ESI C Details. d) While generating invoice in GeM portal, the seller must upload scanned copy of GST invoice and the screenshot of GST portal confirming payment of GST. e) The vehicles to be supplied to Konkan Railway Corporation Ltd. shall be with all features an d fittings and be in good running condition.

f) The vehicles should have valid registration, comprehensive insurance, “Pollution under Con trol Certificate” commercial permit for J&K from RTO. g) The vehicles with sufficient fuel should be supplied and maintained every day preferably w ith the same driver. h) If the condition of vehicle found unsatisfactory, vehicle will not be accepted irrespective of other conditions being fulfilled. i) The contractor shall be required to submit copies of registration certificates, J&K commerci al permit and comprehensive insurance policy of the vehicles being offered for hire along w ith photograph and particulars of the driver and copy of driving license of the driver depute d to each vehicle. j) The vehicles offered for hire should be in good condition particularly in respect of 1.Engine 2. Body 3. Suspension & Tyre 4. Paint 5. Upholstery 6. Decor 7. Matting 8. Lights and over all condition. Vehicles which have suffered major damage in accident shall not be supplied and acceptable to KRCL. k) The inner and outer condition of vehicles should be neat and clean fitted with good quality of fans for rear passenger, reading lights, clock, mobile charger, freshener, clean white to wel seat covers (mandatorily towel seat covers shall be changed fortnightly and for this, a spare set shall be made available) and other required accessories. The contractor shall also provide in the vehicle: extra wheels, jack, proper tools and tackles, one torch, fan belts, Firs t Aid Box, fire extinguishers and any other item as required by law. l) The vehicle should display prominently “On Govt. of India Duty” through permanent letters . m) Vehicles should have Jammu & Kashmir Commercial Permit and all necessary relevant doc uments required along with Insurance Cover for use by KRCL. n) The drivers attached to the vehicle should be experienced, having valid driving license and should be well conversant with the routes of J&K. The driver must observe all the etiquette and protocol while performing the duty. o) The drivers should be disciplined, well behaved, well-mannered and in neat and clean unif orm as per the rules of state govt. p) Drivers of the vehicles are required to be invariably provided with Mobile phones in perfect working condition. No separate payment shall be made by KRCL for the Mobile phones. Unl ess other than in emergency, the driver deployed shall not use the mobile phone while driv ing the vehicle. q) The Drivers should not have any criminal records. The contractor should arrange issue of proper identity card after verifying the antecedents of his drivers through local Governmen t Officials. r) In case of accidents / mishap etc. the full responsibility and all consequences thereof, will li e with the contractor only. No compensation will be paid by KRCL. s) KRCL shall have no direct / indirect liability arising out of such negligent, rash and impetuo

us driving and any losses caused to KRCL have to be fully compensated by the contractor. t) The contractor shall send the vehicles for periodical servicing at the cost of contractor, wit h suitable replacement with similar vehicle. KRCL will not pay any mileage for such run. u) The regular checking of speedometer by the designated transport authority shall be done b y the contractor and requisite certificate may be shown to KRCL as and when demanded. v) The engagement and employment of drivers and payment of wages to them as per existin g provisions of various labour laws and regulations is the sole responsibility of the contract or and any breach of such laws or regulations shall be deemed to be breach of this bid. w) The liability under relevant sections of Civil Defence Act 1968 and IPC causing death or per manent liability developed in the vehicle supplied by the contractor, the hiring authority ha s no responsibility whatsoever and will not entertain any claim in this regard under the pro visions of law. x) The entire relevant Motor Vehicle Act shall be complied with by the contractor. y) Daily Log book to be maintained detailing therein, reporting km, reporting time, releasing km, releasing time etc which will be countersigned by the user officer/officials of KRCL and the Driver with name. z) The vehicles shall generally be used within J&K. However, the vehicles shall also be used ou tside J&K as per requirement of KRCL. However, in case of night halts for each night spent i n actual, outside the nominated head quarter of the user officer, the payment shall be mad e accordingly aa) Contractor shall ensure that sufficient cash is available with the drivers all the time to cove r essential / contingent expenditure and other urgent essential necessities incl. diesel. ab) The vehicle once hired by the Corporation, normally should not be used for any other purpo se during off days and beyond duty hours for any other purpose. Any liability arising out of the work performed after duty hours shall be entirely the responsibility of the contractor an d KRCL shall not be responsible for the same. ac) The vehicles may ply on project roads, most of which are rough/kaccha/fair weather roads. ad) Sunday/Rest day working (except for 24 x 7 variant vehicle) will be paid only as per No. of hours used. The no. of hours used will be paid as per extra hour charges according to serv ice level agreement of GeM. .
